text: When it comes to maintaining your bicycle, tires, brakes, and overall bike maintenance are essential components that need regular attention. Tires are the contact point between your bicycle and the road, significantly influencing your control and safety. Regularly checking tire pressure and checking for wear and tear is key; overinflated or underinflated tires can affect handling and ride quality. Brakes are equally important for stopping power and safety. Ensuring they are in good condition by cleaning and lubricating them, replacing worn-out pads or rotors, and checking for any signs of wear and tear on the braking system can extend the lifespan of your bike. Proper bike maintenance also includes routine checks such as verifying that all components, such as tires, brakes, and chains, are in good condition before each ride. By committing to these regular maintenance tasks, you ensure that your bicycle functions efficiently, safely, and for the longest possible time.
